title: Integrated Cost Sprint Orchestration for Prefetching, Batching, and Quant Profiles
creator: Priya Singh
description: Coordinate a 6-week cross-functional sprint to operationalize a repeatable playbook that safely reduces token unit cost across high-volume workloads by combining prefetch heuristics, continuous batching, and targeted quantization profiles. Deliverables: validation framework, rollout gating, dashboard signals, and automated policy suggestions for Console and Dedicated customers.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end validation harness that runs on representative traffic and reports delta in p50/p95 latency and per-token cost
Console rollout flow with canary gate and automatic rollback configured
Policy suggestion engine surfaces quant profile + batching recommendations in Console and API
Two pilot customers onboarded with documented before/after economics and quality guardrails
notes: 2025-02-15: Kickoff with Eng/Design/ML. Agreed scope: focus first on prefix-aware prefetch + dynamic batch sizing; quant profiles scoped to 8-bit and selected LLMs only.
Design decision (2025-02-20): UI will show a single composite recommendation score instead of separate knobs to reduce cognitive load for early pilots (DES-231 feedback).
Trade-off: aggressive quantization yields 25-40% token savings but increases equiv. hallucination risk for structured outputs. We will gate quantized rollouts behind prompt-set quality checks.
Implementation note: Eng will expose a /suggest endpoint for policy recommendations; initial PR is eng/refactor/suggest-api#112 (GitHub).
Metric targets: target >=12% median unit-econ improvement on synthetic chat workload with <1.5% regression on eval prompt sets.
comments: 2025-02-18 - Ethan Morales: Spiked an offline runner for prefetch heuristics; results look promising for conversational sessions with stable prefixes. Saved ~9% tokens at p50.
2025-02-25 - Priya Singh (PM): Confirmed two pilot customers (RetailBot, DocsSearch) for early field trials; legal approved pilot NDAs.

2025-02-27 - Lina Chen (ML Research): Added a snapshot of eval regressions for quantized vs fp16 on the 'structured-output' benchmark (link in artifacts). Observed small format breakages on <0.5% cases.
2025-03-01 - Engineering sync: Decided to instrument KV cache hit-rate breakdown by user cohort to detect any audience-specific regressions. ENG-8241 assigned.
2025-03-02 - Product review: Approved canary gating criteria: cost savings >8% AND no eval regressions >1% on guard prompt sets. Marking work as In Progress for implementation phase.
